bachelor.description: One laptop (no GPU, modest RAM) that hosts the hub and is its only desktop worker, plus a phone running the APK.

homelab.description: A small hub VM plus two worker VMs; no phone.

gpu-box.description: Later: a cloud hub plus a GPU worker for local models. Not runnable yet.

claude-subscription.description: Claude Code with a subscription token drives the house agent and sessions.

local-only.description: A small CPU model on the laptop behind an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (llama.cpp server). No cloud.

mixed.description: Local fast front (the small CPU model) for the house agent; Claude Code at the back for sessions.

locked-down.description: Everything asks: blanket approval holds on, targets not on the trust map are guarded.

balanced.description: Shipped defaults: blanket holds on for agents' admin calls, unlisted targets balanced (changes go, admin asks).

yolo.description: Agents just go: blanket holds off, unlisted targets ship-it.

scenarios.title: Install the hub from zero with the one-command installer
Pair the laptop as a worker with a dashboard pairing code
Install the APK and pair the phone
Apply the trust preset the way a person would
Make the model profile available (Claude Code sign-in or a local model server)
First text request to the house agent
'Fix this bug' in a toy repo, end to end (session to a PR)
An approval path: a held call, approved by the operator, runs once
Kill a worker mid-call; it comes back and the band recovers
The house agent learns one preference and uses it next turn
